changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: The standard construction work categories for every organization that existed before WorkCategorySeeder, which adds them to organizations created from now on. Keyed on the organization plus the normalized name (or the raw name), so a category an organization already holds is left as it is and a rerun inserts nothing. Normalized names follow CategoryNormalizer: lower case, ampersand to "and", other punctuation dropped.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO category (category_name, normalized_name, category_description, organization_id) SELECT s.name, s.normalized, s.description, o.id FROM organization o CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1, 'Preliminaries & Site Setup', 'preliminaries and site setup', 'Initial activities required to mobilize, establish, survey, secure, and prepare the construction site for project execution.'), (2, 'Earthwork', 'earthwork', 'Activities involving site clearing, excavation, earth cutting, soil removal, filling, backfilling, compaction, grading, and leveling.'), (3, 'Foundation Works', 'foundation works', 'Construction of foundations and associated works, including PCC, footings, rafts, piles, pile caps, waterproofing, and backfilling.'), (4, 'Concrete Works', 'concrete works', 'Production, placement, pumping, finishing, and curing of structural and non-structural concrete, including RCC and ready-mix concrete.'), (5, 'Reinforcement Works', 'reinforcement works', 'Fabrication and installation of steel reinforcement, including cutting, bending, fixing, mesh, couplers, and binding.'), (6, 'Formwork / Shuttering', 'formwork shuttering', 'Temporary mould and support systems used to form concrete elements such as footings, columns, beams, slabs, walls, and stairs.'), (7, 'Structural Steel Works', 'structural steel works', 'Fabrication, erection, connection, welding, bolting, coating, and decking activities associated with structural steel construction.'), (8, 'Masonry Works', 'masonry works', 'Construction of brick, block, AAC, stone, partition, internal, and external wall systems.'), (9, 'Plastering & Rendering', 'plastering and rendering', 'Application of plaster, render, and related surface treatments to internal, external, ceiling, and repaired surfaces.'), (10, 'Waterproofing', 'waterproofing', 'Installation of systems that protect roofs, toilets, basements, terraces, tanks, and joints from water ingress.'), (11, 'Roofing', 'roofing', 'Construction and finishing of roof systems including RCC, metal, tile, sheet roofing, insulation, and drainage.'), (12, 'Flooring', 'flooring', 'Installation of floor finishes including PCC, tiles, vitrified tiles, ceramic, granite, marble, stone, industrial, epoxy, and vinyl flooring.'), (13, 'Wall Finishes', 'wall finishes', 'Application and installation of wall surface finishes such as tiles, ceramic finishes, stone cladding, paint, wallpaper, and decorative treatments.'), (14, 'Ceiling Works', 'ceiling works', 'Installation and finishing of false, gypsum, grid, and metal ceilings, including insulation and ceiling painting.'), (15, 'Doors & Windows', 'doors and windows', 'Supply and installation of doors, windows, curtain walls, glazing systems, and associated hardware and fittings.'), (16, 'Painting Works', 'painting works', 'Surface preparation and application of primer, putty, interior and exterior paints, enamel, protective, and waterproof coatings.'), (17, 'Plumbing', 'plumbing', 'Installation of water supply, drainage, sanitary piping, pumps, tanks, sanitary fixtures, and plumbing fixtures.'), (18, 'Electrical Works', 'electrical works', 'Installation of electrical conduits, wiring, cables, distribution boards, switches, sockets, lighting, earthing, lightning protection, and generator connections.'), (19, 'HVAC', 'hvac', 'Installation and commissioning of heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems including ducting, piping, AHUs, FCUs, VRF/VRV, ventilation, and controls.'), (20, 'Fire & Life Safety', 'fire and life safety', 'Installation of fire protection and life-safety systems including hydrants, sprinklers, alarms, extinguishers, pumps, fire-rated doors, emergency lighting, and fire stopping.'), (21, 'ELV / Low Voltage Systems', 'elv low voltage systems', 'Installation of low-voltage and building technology systems such as CCTV, access control, networking, structured cabling, public address, intercom, BMS, and security systems.'), (22, 'External Development', 'external development', 'Development of external site infrastructure including roads, paving, footpaths, kerbs, parking, drainage, boundary walls, gates, and landscaping.'), (23, 'Utilities & Infrastructure', 'utilities and infrastructure', 'Installation of site and project utility infrastructure including water, sewerage, stormwater, electrical systems, transformers, DG systems, and utility trenches.'), (24, 'Specialized Works', 'specialized works', 'Specialized building and industrial systems including lifts, escalators, solar systems, building automation, acoustic works, clean rooms, and specialized installations.'), (25, 'Testing, Commissioning & Handover', 'testing commissioning and handover', 'Inspection, testing, commissioning, snagging, rectification, documentation, and final handover of completed construction works and systems.'), (26, 'Demolition & Renovation', 'demolition and renovation', 'Removal, dismantling, repair, renovation, retrofitting, restoration, and debris clearance associated with existing structures.'), (27, 'Site Logistics', 'site logistics', 'Management and movement of materials, equipment, machinery, lifting operations, storage, unloading, internal transportation, and site waste.'), (28, 'Safety & Environmental', 'safety and environmental', 'Activities supporting construction safety and environmental management, including PPE, fall protection, dust and noise control, waste disposal, monitoring, and housekeeping.') ) AS s(ord, name, normalized, description) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM category c WHERE c.organization_id = o.id AND (c.normalized_name = s.normalized OR c.category_name = s.name)) ORDER BY o.id, s.ord
